note: Nomination-day report for the eighteen divisions of Newtownards (North Down) rural district, one member each. Thirteen divisions received a single nomination and are listed here; in Groomsport, Crawfordsburn, Kilmood, Kircubbin and Newtownards South no nomination was made and the retiring members were deemed re-elected, but their names were not printed. Filed on 1930-05-30, the Co. Down county and rural district polling day that year (previously filed under 1930-06-05; moved 6 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
